signedChecklist.observed: 18 workspace snapshots and 15 recovery snapshots matched. Sequence 1 completed and reopened the saved task. Sequences 2 and 4 required confirmation before one durable event each. Rollbacks 3 and 5 reused the original guest and preserved workspace bytes at activation. User actions produced one projectCreated and six taskSaved events, with each prior outbox prefix retained. Done removed the active attempt and staged marker for the same healthy sequence-5 candidate and launch. The healthy identity and revision-7 workspace stayed byte-identical, and the ordinary UI showed 1/1 complete, 7 pending, an enabled launcher and no checklist dialog.
signedChecklist.outage: Sequence 4 was truncated. The same 2112-byte partial record survived both loopback listeners stopping, with the ADB reverse mapping still configured. New PID 5302 after 2568 opened the same sequence-3 candidate under a fresh launch, recorded unknown_interruption_after_effects and kept revision 6 and six events unchanged. Restart served the same sequence-4 artifact and the app completed the fetch. The relay performs full GETs, so this does not prove byte-range resumption.
signedChecklist.cleanup: Both origin and relay generations, the UID logger, emulator and private ADB have terminal exit and group-absence records. The exact reverse mapping was removed, owned ports were reusable, and instance and origin scratch were reclaimed.
